_comment: Hand-authored region(name)->module map for component.go, built from plan.md §2. Keys are the raw '// #region' label text (emoji+name). Duplicate names that mean different things in different places are disambiguated via lineOverrides (checked first). module 'UNMAPPED' / entries flagged 'REVIEW' in _flagged need a human pass.

lineOverrides.note: This '🎙️GraphQL' region is nested under 🦀️Mcp (34661-36087): a small GraphQL-query helper used by MCP tool handlers, not the language-plugin '🎙️GraphQL' entry at 15237-15267 (which maps to languages via nameToModule).

conflicts: 🌧️Cli Adapter (604-9879, and duplicated stray '// #endregion 🌧️Cli Adapter' at 9881) is the 'broken depth-1' region named in the ticket: the marker balance inside it does not round-trip cleanly (see e.g. the extra endregion at 9881 and the '⚙️Types' region at 13192 being closed early by the stray '// #endregion 🧊️Policies' at 21613 instead of the missing '// #region 🧊️Policies'). The tool's blind depth-only stack still produces a usable innermost-region label for every decl, but a few boundary decls right around 9879-9881 and 13192/18420-21615 may carry an off-by-one region; verified against plan.md §2 by hand for the regions that matter (Policies, Codebase, Types) and corrected via the 'Policies' virtual splice done in code and the ⚙️Types->languages umbrella mapping.

🪅️Analyze Command appears twice (946-1011 under Cli Adapter, 36106-36154 under 🔊️Cli near GraphQL Helpers); both map to 'statutes' per plan.md wording ('statutes: ... analyze, fix'), even though the enclosing region is a CLI 'Command' — the command wraps statutes business logic and dispatches into it.
📃️Fix Command (36156-36190) similarly maps to 'statutes' for the same reason as Analyze Command.

🪝️TicketMcpHandlers (46849-46895) is MCP-facing wiring for ticket tools; mapped to 'tickets' as the owning business module, but it is really the tickets/mcp seam and may need to move to mcp as a thin adapter once split.
⚡️Server Client (39682-39779) talks to the coordinator server; mapped to 'cli' as a default since it is invoked from CLI commands, but it could equally be argued to live under 'providers'.

💾️Missing Utility Functions, 🖋️Missing Tool Functions, 🧬️Missing Utilities, 🎼️Utilities are generic catch-all regions with mixed content (the file's incremental 'Missing X' patches); mapped to 'cli' as a fallback and flagged for manual per-declaration re-triage once go-split (wave 2) runs, since some individual declarations inside them plainly belong to other modules (e.g. tree/graphql helpers) by name.
🎼️Args, 🔧️Paths, 🏬️Mcp Resources Handlers, 🪄️Handlers, 🪪️McpClientKind, 🗣️McpDescriptions, 🦀️McpServerFactory are all nested under 🦀️Mcp (34661-36087) and map to 'mcp'.

⭐️Codebase Types (16444-16747) is nested under 🎽️Languages (13335-16749) textually but per plan.md belongs to 'model' ('Codebase Types' explicitly listed under 📐️model), not 'languages' or 'codebase'.
